questions.prompt: Outlines where white is required are printed with a carved block and a lime and tree-gum _____.

sentence.text: Printed on harde-treated cloth, kut develops a deep fast chocolate-black as iron reacts with the tannic acid.

citations.quote: When printed onto the harde treated cloth kut develops a deep fast chocolate-black colour as the iron particles in the kut paste oxidise with the tannic acid.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 6

sentence.text: Areas where black is required are printed with kut paste, usually an infill (datla) between khariyanu outlines.

citations.quote: Areas where black is required are now printed with kut paste. In true Ajrakh, this is usually an infill or datla between selected khariyanu outliners.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 6

sentence.text: Pa, a smooth paste of alum in tamarind-seed paste, is printed with blocks patterned for the mavi areas where red is required.

citations.quote: This smooth paste called Pa, is printed with blocks which have been carved so that the printing portion of the raised face is patterned only, with the areas of the design called mavi, where red is required.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 6

citations.quote: Alum is suspended in a sticky paste of boiled powder from roasted and ground tamarind seeds (locally known as kachika).
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 6

sentence.text: Outlines where white is required are printed with a carved block and a lime and tree-gum resist paste.

citations.quote: Preparation of Outline of design (Khariyanu/ Kiriyana):- Outlines of the design, where white is required, are printed with a carved wooden block and a resist paste containing lime and tree gum.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 6

questions.prompt: Presence of iron in the water supply dulls and darkens the final result; _____, tin or chrome deposits help brighten colours.

sentence.text: Presence of iron in the water supply dulls and darkens the final result; alum, tin or chrome deposits help brighten colours.

citations.quote: Water enriched with alum, tin or chrome mineral deposits will help brighten the colors but presence of iron in the water supply dulls and darkens the final result.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 8

sentence.text: Gach with alum is printed where larger red areas are required (red ground gudh or mavi infill); the clay and millet resist indigo while the alum acts as mordant.

citations.quote: Alum is added to half of this paste, and printed where larger areas of the Red are required in a design, for example a red background gudh or infill areas called mavi.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 7

citations.quote: The clay and millet flour in the paste act as a resist, preventing indigo from staining the cloth beneath, whilst the alum content acts a mordant for subsequent application of red dye.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 7

sentence.text: Ajrakh colours come from indigo, madder and iron acetate.

citations.quote: 1 The colors are created with a complex process of resist and mordant printing, and dyeing with indigo, madder, and iron acetate (Figure 3).
citations.locator: § "Indigo in Kutch, India: Art and Science, Environment and Economics"

sentence.text: Ajrakh printing got concentrated where extra soft water was available.

citations.quote: The district gazetteers of 1971 have mentioned that Ajrakh Printing-Ajrakh is another popular variety in hand-printing of textiles in Kutch. Ajrakh printing originally came from Sindh and got concentrated where extra soft water was available.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 3
